explanation: Requested eta electroproduction at W=1.4885 GeV is only ~2.4 MeV above the ep->e'peta threshold (W_th ~ 1.486 GeV). The EtaMAID-2023 table covers W=1.4856-6 GeV (step 10 MeV then 100 MeV), so 1.4885 requires interpolation between the first two W bins. The point is physically allowed (Q2=0.5 GeV2, cos theta*=0.2, phi*=60 deg satisfy s and two-body kinematics with beam 6.535 GeV), but near-threshold phase space is tiny (p* ~ 40 MeV/c). The EXCLURAD README explicitly warns to use the unphysical-skip runner for runs near the eta threshold because integration can hit NAG d01fce failures (ifail=2 — the legacy terminating line in the input). No compiler/shell is available per LEGD_CONDITION.md, so I could not run the executable to verify. I preserved the standard eta settings (model=3, rc_mode=0 full O(alpha), bmom=6.535 GeV, ivec=1 proton, vcut=0.166 GeV2 CLAS12 cut) and included the required trailing error-termination line. Recommendation: run with skip_unphys and treat any NAG error as expected near threshold rather than a code failure.
